title: Leveraging AI to Make Data Driven Business Decisions

facts.fact: The article was published by Team AirWorks on April 1, 2020.
The article describes artificial intelligence as commonly known as a type of computer software that can engage in learning, planning and problem-solving.
facts.quote: AI, is commonly known as a type of computer software that can engage in learning, planning and problem-solving.

facts.fact: AirWorks describes itself as an AI-powered software that allows firms in the built world to have perfect CAD drawings in record time (vendor's own description, no numeric timeframe given).
facts.quote: AirWorks is an AI-powered software that allows firms in the built world to have perfect CAD drawings in record time.
